description:
The Project-Env CLI represents the raw core of Project-Env which allows the setup of tools based on a project-env.toml configuration file and therefore the integration of Project-Env into an existing environment.


🚀 New features and improvements
- Make the sh template Windows compatible and call Maven through a function (#354) @repolevedavaj, @claude
- Fix Git hooks installation in linked worktrees and submodules (#360) @repolevedavaj, @claude
📦 Dependency updates
- Update all Maven and GitHub Action dependencies (#361) @repolevedavaj, @claude
